capabilities: Resize vault images with linked or independent dimensions
Convert images between JPEG, PNG, and WebP
Compress images toward an optional maximum file size
Replace an embedded image in a note with the resized copy
Save resized copies beside originals with optional trash cleanup
extras: README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and recommends testing in a separate vault before using it with important files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to resize, convert, or compress image files stored in the vault without external tools or uploads.
summary: Image tool that resizes, converts between JPEG, PNG, and WebP, and compresses vault images locally while preserving the originals.
